description: Sauce Demo requirements used as input for AI test-case generation. Error messages match what tests/ui asserts against the real site.

requirements.text: A user with a valid username and password signs in and lands on the Products page.
Signing in without a username shows the error 'Epic sadface: Username is required'.
Signing in with a username but no password shows the error 'Epic sadface: Password is required'.
The user locked_out_user cannot sign in and sees 'Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out.'
The cart badge shows how many items are in the cart; removing an item decreases it, and an empty cart shows no badge.
Checkout requires first name, last name and postal code; a missing field shows 'Error: <Field> is required' for the first missing field.
The order summary total equals the item subtotal plus tax.
